newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - New Britain, Conn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - New Britain, Conn.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the City of New Britain, Connecticut (the City'') at City Hall, 27 West Main Street, 2nd Floor, Mayor's Conference Room, New

for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery, of the whole of the City's $22,440,000 General Obligation Bonds - Issue of 1997, dated April 15, 1997, maturing April 15 in the principal amount and years as set forth below:
Due Amount Due Amount Due Amount

The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. The City expects to direct purchase a credit enhancement facility for the Bonds. The Bonds will not be designated as qualified tax-exempt obligations,'' will be certified by Citizens Trust Company, Providence, Rhode Island, and

delivered against payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, on or about April 15, 1997, subject to the approving opinion of Levy & Droney, P.C. of Farmington, Connecticut. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only system with the Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities depository.

Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the City's Official Statement may be obtained from John Jedrzejczyk, Finance Director, City Hall, 27 West Main Street, New Britain, Connecticut 06051, telephone (860) 826-3434.
